purpose: Executable synthetic witness for explicit evidence transport across model classes without changing source class or scope.

sources.domain_of_validity: Synthetic two-layer energy-balance response under one fixed forcing protocol and declared four-point comparison grid.
Synthetic emulator evaluated on the same forcing protocol and four-point comparison grid; no parent-GCM or observational validity is implied.

bridge.bridge_assumption: Only the declared intervention response on the shared coordinate and unit is treated as transferable; model class, domain of validity, and evidence scope remain source-specific.

forbidden_promotions.reason: Emulator agreement does not validate an unexecuted parent GCM.
Multimodel agreement is not observational support without an observation source.
